14	STEPS_LABEL = "environment steps"
15	# The dataviz skill's reference palette (light mode): categorical slot 1 and the chart chrome.
16	SERIES = "#2a78d6"
17	SURFACE = "#fcfcfb"
18	INK = "#0b0b0b"
19	SECONDARY = "#52514e"
20	MUTED = "#898781"
21	GRID = "#e1e0d9"

25	def learning_curve(
26	    runs: Sequence[Run], baselines: BaselineMeans, out: Path, *, measure: str | None = None
27	) -> Output:
28	    figure = draw_curves(runs, baselines, measure)
29	    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
30	    figure.savefig(out)
31	    figure.savefig(out.with_suffix(".svg"))
32	    return Output(out, "chart", tuple(run.record.config.name for run in runs))
33	
34	
35	def draw_curves(runs: Sequence[Run], baselines: BaselineMeans, measure: str | None) -> Figure:
36	    """One panel per team (or one for `measure`): mean line, min-max band, baseline lines."""
37	    if not runs:
38	        raise ValueError("no runs to chart")
39	    spec = runs[0].record.spec
40	    panels = _panels(spec, measure)
41	    figure = Figure(figsize=(6.4 * len(panels), 4.2), facecolor=SURFACE, layout="constrained")
42	    axes = figure.subplots(1, len(panels), squeeze=False)[0]
43	    for ax, (team, label) in zip(axes, panels, strict=True):
44	        steps, values = _series(runs, team, measure)
45	        _draw_band(ax, steps, values, f"{team}: {label}, {len(runs)} runs")

53	    """(team, y-axis label) per panel: each team's score, or the declared measure's team."""
54	    if measure is None:
55	        return [(team.name, team.score_name) for team in spec.teams]
56	    declared = [m for m in spec.measures if m.name == measure]
57	    if not declared:

def rule_for(world: str, variant: str, team: str) -> RulePolicy:
    """The rule baseline of `team` in `world`'s `variant`; `KeyError` naming all three if none."""
    match (world, variant, team):
        case ("snake", "default", "snake"):
            return SnakeRule()
    raise KeyError(f"no rule for team {team!r} of world {world!r}, variant {variant!r}")


def baseline_means(world: str, variant: str) -> BaselineMeans:
    """Random and rule mean score per team on `EVAL_SEEDS`, each against rule-based opponents."""
    try:
        played = make(world, variant)
    except ValueError as error:
        raise KeyError(f"no rule for world {world!r}, variant {variant!r}: {error}") from error
    spec = played.spec
    random: dict[str, float] = {}
    rule: dict[str, float] = {}
    for team in spec.teams:
        opponents: dict[str, Policy] = {
            other.name: rule_for(world, variant, other.name)
            for other in spec.teams
            if other.name != team.name
        }
        random[team.name] = mean_score(
            played, {**opponents, team.name: RandomPolicy(spec.action)}, team.name
        )
        rule[team.name] = mean_score(
            played, {**opponents, team.name: rule_for(world, variant, team.name)}, team.name
        )
    return BaselineMeans(world=world, variant=variant, random=random, rule=rule)

    """`team`'s mean score over one episode per evaluation seed."""
    return fmean(play_episode(world, policies, seed).result.scores[team] for seed in EVAL_SEEDS)
